description: This file is a PHP source file for a web-based router configuration interface, specifically for managing wireless network settings including Wi-Fi radios, SSID configurations, security modes, WPS, band steering, and related controls. It contains PHP code for data retrieval and HTML/JavaScript for rendering the UI and handling user interactions.

methods.name: update_Wi_Fi_control_list
methods.description: Updates the Wi-Fi control list via AJAX call, refreshing filtering mode and auto-learned device tables based on selected SSID.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends configuration changes to the server via AJAX and reloads the page to apply updates.

methods.name: show_extch
methods.description: Displays or hides extension channel options based on selected channel number.

methods.name: check_add
methods.description: Validates input for manually adding a device to the Wi-Fi control list, including device name and MAC address.

methods.name: adjust_row
methods.description: Reindexes and styles rows in a table, typically after add/remove operations to maintain logical order.

methods.name: add_row
methods.description: Adds a new row to specified table (filter or auto) with device information, ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: del_row
methods.description: Deletes a row from the control list table after user confirmation.

methods.name: add_auto
methods.description: Copies a device from auto-learned list to manual control list.

methods.name: save_filter
methods.description: Collects filter settings and sends to server for saving.

methods.name: save_config
methods.description: Collects wireless configuration parameters and sends them to server for update.

methods.name: save_enable
methods.description: Saves enable/disable state for Wi-Fi radios and WPS settings.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates a WPS PIN checksum for correctness.

methods.name: pair_client
methods.description: Initiates WPS pairing process with specified device and method.

methods.name: showSteeringHistoryDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog with band steering history fetched from server.

methods.name: steering_history
methods.description: Fetches and displays band steering history data via AJAX.

methods.name: saveBandSteeringSettings
methods.description: Saves band steering configuration parameters via AJAX.
